1-resize-one-card.png: In Six view on a computer, drag the edge beside a card to resize just that card: here the Gainers Table gets wider and the room beside it narrower, while the cards in the row below stay put
2-each-card-keeps-its-width.png: Resize as many cards as you like, one at a time: each keeps its own width, saved to your account so it follows you to any computer
3-double-click-to-put-it-back.png: Double-click the edge to put that card back to its normal width. The other cards keep theirs, and Reset widths still evens out every card
